verses.en: A great and marvelous work is about to come forth unto the children of men.
verses.sm: Ua Lē pine ona oo mai o se galuega tele ma le ofoofogia i le fanauga a tagata.

verses.en: Behold, I am God; give heed unto my word, which is quick and powerful, sharper than a two-edged sword, to the dividing asunder of both joints and marrow; therefore give heed unto my words.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u o le Atua; ia uai mai i la’u upu, lea ua vave ma mamana, ua sili atu le maai nai lo se pelu mata-lua, e vavae ai sooga o ivi ma le su; o lea ia uai mai ai i a’u upu.

verses.en: Behold, the field is white already to harvest; therefore, whoso desireth to reap, let him thrust in his sickle with his might, and reap while the day lasts, that he may treasure up for his soul everlasting salvation in the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua sinasina le fanua ua saunia e selesele; o lea, ai se e fia selesele, ia tuu ia te ia e sasau atu lana selesaito ma lona malosi, ma selesele mai manū o ao, ina ia mafai ona ia teu mo lona agaga le olataga tumau e faavavau i le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: Yea, whosoever will thrust in his sickle and reap, the same is called of God.
verses.sm: Ioe, ai se tasi e sasau atu lana selesaito ma selesele mai, o ia lava lea ua valaaulia e le Atua.

verses.en: Therefore, if you will ask of me you shall receive; if you will knock it shall be opened unto you.
verses.sm: O lea, afai tou te ole mai ia te a’u o le a outou mauaina; afai tou te tuitui mai o le a tatala atu ia te outou.

verses.en: Now, as you have asked, behold, I say unto you, keep my commandments, and seek to bring forth and establish the cause of Zion;
verses.sm: O lenei, ona ua oulua ole mai, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te oulua, tausi i a’u poloaiga, ma saili e aumai i luma ma faatu le faamoemoe o Siona.

verses.en: Seek not for riches but for wisdom, and behold, the mysteries of God shall be unfolded unto you, and then shall you be made rich. Behold, he that hath eternal life is rich.
verses.sm: Aua le saili mo ’oa ae mo le poto, ma faauta, o le a fofola atu ia te oe mealilo a le Atua, ona faamauoaina ai lea o oe. Faauta, o ia o lē ua ia maua le ola e faavavau, ua mauoa o ia.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, even as you desire of me so it shall be unto you; and if you desire, you shall be the means of doing much good in this generation.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, e pei ona e manao mai ai ia te a’u, o le a faapea lava ona tuu atu ia te oe; ma afai e te manao i ai, o le a avea oe ma ala o le faia o mea lelei e tele i le tupulaga lenei.

verses.en: Say nothing but repentance unto this generation; keep my commandments, and assist to bring forth my work, according to my commandments, and you shall be blessed.
verses.sm: Ia leai se mea e te fai atu i lenei tupulaga tau lava o le salamo; tausi i a’u poloaiga, ma fesoasoani e aumai i luma la’u galuega, e tusa ma a’u poloaiga, ma o le a faamanuiaina oe.

verses.en: Behold thou hast a gift, and blessed art thou because of thy gift. Remember it is sacred and cometh from above—
verses.sm: Faauta, ua ia te oe se meaalofa, ma amuia oe ona o lau meaalofa. Ia manatua ua paia ma ua sau mai lugā—

verses.en: And if thou wilt inquire, thou shalt know mysteries which are great and marvelous; therefore thou shalt exercise thy gift, that thou mayest find out mysteries, that thou mayest bring many to the knowledge of the truth, yea, convince them of the error of their ways.
verses.sm: Ma afai e te ole atu, o le a e iloa mealilo ua silisili ma ofoofogia; o lea ia e faaaoga ai lau meaalofa, ina ia mafai ona e iloa o mealilo, ina ia mafai ona e aumai o le toatele i le malamalama o le upumoni, ioe, e faatalitonu ai i latou i le sese o o latou ala.

verses.en: Make not thy gift known unto any save it be those who are of thy faith. Trifle not with sacred things.
verses.sm: Aua le faailoa atu lau meaalofa i se tasi vagana ai i latou o e o lou faatuatuaga. Aua le faatauvaaina mea paia.

verses.en: If thou wilt do good, yea, and hold out faithful to the end, thou shalt be saved in the kingdom of God, which is the greatest of all the gifts of God; for there is no gift greater than the gift of salvation.
verses.sm: Afai e te faia mea lelei, ioe, ma tumau faamaoni e oo i le iuga, o le a faaolaina oe i le malo o le Atua, o le meaalofa aupito silisili lea o meaalofa uma a le Atua; ona ua leai se meaalofa e sili atu nai lo le meaalofa o le olataga.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, blessed art thou for what thou hast done; for thou hast inquired of me, and behold, as often as thou hast inquired thou hast received instruction of my Spirit. If it had not been so, thou wouldst not have come to the place where thou art at this time.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, amuia oe ona o mea ua e faia; aua sa e ole mai ia te a’u, ma faauta, o le tele o taimi na e ole mai ai na e maua ai faatonuga mai lo’u Agaga. A na fai e lē faapea, po ua e lē oo mai i le mea ua e i ai i le taimi nei.

verses.en: Behold, thou knowest that thou hast inquired of me and I did enlighten thy mind; and now I tell thee these things that thou mayest know that thou hast been enlightened by the Spirit of truth;
verses.sm: Faauta, ua e iloa na e ole mai ia te a’u ma sa Ou faapupulaina lou mafaufau; ma o lenei ua Ou tau atu ia te oe nei mea ina ia mafai ona e iloa ai sa faapupulaina oe e le Agaga o le upumoni;

verses.en: Yea, I tell thee, that thou mayest know that there is none else save God that knowest thy thoughts and the intents of thy heart.
verses.sm: Ioe, ua Ou tau atu ia te oe, ina ia mafai ona e iloa e leai lava se tasi ae ua nao le Atua ua ia silafia ou mafaufauga ma faamoemoega o lou loto.

verses.en: I tell thee these things as a witness unto thee—that the words or the work which thou hast been writing are true.
verses.sm: Ua Ou tau atu ia te oe nei mea o se molimau ia te oe— o upu po o le galuega na e tusia ua moni.

verses.en: Therefore be diligent; stand by my servant Joseph, faithfully, in whatsoever difficult circumstances he may be for the word’s sake.
verses.sm: O lea ia e filiga; tulai i tafatafa o la’u auauna, o Iosefa, ma le faamaoni, i soo se tulaga faigata atonu e i ai o ia, ona o le afioga.

verses.en: Admonish him in his faults, and also receive admonition of him. Be patient; be sober; be temperate; have patience, faith, hope and charity.
verses.sm: Timai atu ia te ia i ona sese, ma ia e talia foi timaiga mai ia te ia. Ia onosai; ia faamamalu; ia faautauta; ia ia te oe le faapalepale, faatuatua, faamoemoe ma le alofa mama.

verses.en: Behold, thou art Oliver, and I have spoken unto thee because of thy desires; therefore treasure up these words in thy heart. Be faithful and diligent in keeping the commandments of God, and I will encircle thee in the arms of my love.
verses.sm: Faauta, o oe o Oliva, ma ua Ou tautala atu ia te oe ona o ou manao; o lea ia teu nei upu i lou loto. Ia e faamaoni ma filiga i le tausiga o poloaiga a le Atua, ma o le a Ou siomia ai oe i lima o lo’u alofa.

verses.en: Behold, I am Jesus Christ, the Son of God. I am the same that came unto mine own, and mine own received me not. I am the light which shineth in darkness, and the darkness comprehendeth it not.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u o Iesu Keriso, o le Atalii o le Atua. O A’u lava lea na sau i lo’u lava nuu, ae sa lē talia a’u e lo’u lava nuu. O A’u o le malamalama ua susulu i le pouliuli, ae ua lē malamalama i ai le pouliuli.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, if you desire a further witness, cast your mind upon the night that you cried unto me in your heart, that you might know concerning the truth of these things.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, afai e te manao i se isi molimau, liliu ane lou mafaufau i le po na e tagi mai ai ia te a’u i lou loto, ina ia mafai ona e iloa e uiga i le moni o nei mea.

verses.en: Did I not speak peace to your mind concerning the matter? What greater witness can you have than from God?
verses.sm: Ou te lei tautala atu ea le filemu i lou mafaufau e uiga i le mataupu? O le a se molimau sili atu e mafai ona e maua mai lo lena mai le Atua?

verses.en: And now, behold, you have received a witness; for if I have told you things which no man knoweth have you not received a witness?
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, ua e maua se molimau; aua afai ua Ou tau atu ia te oe mea e leai se tagata na te iloaina, ua e lē mauaina ea se molimau?

verses.en: And, behold, I grant unto you a gift, if you desire of me, to translate, even as my servant Joseph.
verses.sm: Ma, faauta, Ou te tuu atu ia te oe se meaalofa, pe afai e te manao i ai mai ia te a’u, e faaliliu, e pei lava o la’u auauna o Iosefa.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that there are records which contain much of my gospel, which have been kept back because of the wickedness of the people;
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, o loo i ai ni talafaamaumau ua i ai i totonu le tele o la’u talalelei, sa taofia ona o le amioleaga o tagata;

verses.en: And now I command you, that if you have good desires—a desire to lay up treasures for yourself in heaven—then shall you assist in bringing to light, with your gift, those parts of my scriptures which have been hidden because of iniquity.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei Ou te poloai atu ia te oe, afai ua ia te oe manaoga lelei— se manao lea ia teu mo oe lava ni ’oa i le lagi— ona mafai lea ona e fesoasoani e aumai i le malamalama, ma lau meaalofa, o vaega na o a’u tusitusiga paia lea sa natia ona o le amioletonu.

verses.en: And now, behold, I give unto you, and also unto my servant Joseph, the keys of this gift, which shall bring to light this ministry; and in the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, Ou te tuu atu ia te oe, ma la’u auauna foi o Iosefa, ki o lenei meaalofa, o le a aumai ai i le malamalama lenei auaunaga; ma o fofoga o molimau e toalua pe toatolu e faamautu ai upu uma.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, if they reject my words, and this part of my gospel and ministry, blessed are ye, for they can do no more unto you than unto me.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oulua, afai latou te teena a’u upu, ma le vaega lenei o la’u talalelei ma la’u auaunaga, amuia oulua, ona e lē mafai ona sili atu se mea latou te faia ia te oulua nai lo ia te a’u.

verses.en: And even if they do unto you even as they have done unto me, blessed are ye, for you shall dwell with me in glory.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa pe latou te faia ia te oulua e pei lava ona sa latou faia ia te a’u, amuia oulua, ona o le a oulua mau faatasi ma a’u i le mamalu.

verses.en: But if they reject not my words, which shall be established by the testimony which shall be given, blessed are they, and then shall ye have joy in the fruit of your labors.
verses.sm: Ae afai latou te lē teena a’u upu, ia o le a faamautuina i le molimau o le a tuu atu, amuia i latou, ma ona oulua maua ai lea o le olioli i le fua o a oulua galuega.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, as I said unto my disciples, where two or three are gathered together in my name, as touching one thing, behold, there will I be in the midst of them—even so am I in the midst of you.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oulua, e pei ona ou fai atu i o’u soo, o le mea e potopoto faatasi ai le toalua po o le toatolu i lo’u igoa, e faatatau i se mea e tasi, faauta, o iina o le a Ou i ai i le lotolotoi o i latou— e faapei lava ona Ou i ai ia te oulua.

verses.en: Fear not to do good, my sons, for whatsoever ye sow, that shall ye also reap; therefore, if ye sow good ye shall also reap good for your reward.
verses.sm: Aua le fefefe e fai mea lelei, o’u atalii e, auā o soo se mea e te lua lulu, o lena foi o le a oulua selesele; o lea, afai lua te luluina le lelei o le a oulua seleseleina foi le lelei mo lo oulua taui.

verses.en: Therefore, fear not, little flock; do good; let earth and hell combine against you, for if ye are built upon my rock, they cannot prevail.
verses.sm: O lea, aua le matatau, le lafu itiiti e; fai mea lelei; ia tuu le lalolagi ma seoli e aufaatasi faasaga mai ia te oulua, auā afai ua lua atia’e i luga o la’u papa, e lē mafai ona latou manumalo.

verses.en: Behold, I do not condemn you; go your ways and sin no more; perform with soberness the work which I have commanded you.
verses.sm: Faauta, ou te lē tausalaina oulua; o i o oulua ala ma ia lē toe agasala; fai ma le mamalu le galuega ua Ou poloaiina ai oulua.

verses.en: Look unto me in every thought; doubt not, fear not.
verses.sm: Vaai mai ia te a’u i mafaufauga uma; aua le masalosalo, aua le fefefe.

verses.en: Behold the wounds which pierced my side, and also the prints of the nails in my hands and feet; be faithful, keep my commandments, and ye shall inherit the kingdom of heaven. Amen.
verses.sm: Faauta i manu’a ua tuia ai lo’u itu, ma tulaga fao foi i o’u lima ma o’u vae; ia faamaoni, tausi i a’u poloaiga, ma o le a oulua mautofi ai i le malo o le lagi. Amene.
